records.title: CUDABeaver: Benchmarking LLM-Based Automated CUDA Debugging
records.reason: CUDABeaver is an evaluation benchmark for LLM-based CUDA debugging and exposes correctness/repair-by-degeneration issues. It evaluates code-debugging agents, not the runtime or efficiency of LLM inference.

records.title: Continuity Laws for Sequential Models
records.reason: Continuity Laws studies temporal continuity as an inductive bias in sequential models and evaluates task prediction behavior. It does not address LLM inference resources or serving.

records.title: Kernel Foundry: A Diagnosis-driven Evolutionary Kernel Optimizer with Multi-Experts
records.reason: Kernel Foundry is an LLM-guided evolutionary system for generating and optimizing Triton kernels and reports speedups on KernelBench. It improves generated kernel execution, but the evaluated target is generic kernel tasks rather than LLM model inference kernels or an LLM serving stack; the linked inference-systems lineage leaves a plausible, limited compiler connection.
